title: INTRODUCING RANGE ROVER SPORT ELECTRIC: THE PINNACLE OF SPORTING LUXURY | Range Rover Media Newsroom
description: Range Rover has confirmed the forthcoming arrival of its second EV, Range Rover Sport Electric, which signals a new era of sporting luxury.

headings.text: INTRODUCING RANGE ROVER SPORT ELECTRIC: THE PINNACLE OF SPORTING LUXURY

body: Range Rover has confirmed the forthcoming arrival of its second EV, Range Rover Sport Electric, which signals a new era of sporting luxury.
Dynamism electrified: Range Rover Sport Electric will usher in a new era of sporting luxury – promising to be more dynamic and faster than ever
Coming soon: Full details of New Range Rover Sport Electric to be revealed later in 2026. Keep informed at www.rangerover.com
GOODWOOD, UK – 16 JULY 2026: Range Rover has confirmed the forthcoming arrival of its second EV, Range Rover Sport Electric, which signals a new era of sporting luxury.

Following the much‑anticipated Range Rover Electric, which has been previewed at a series of curated events over the British Summer Season, Range Rover Sport will again redefine the luxury electric SUV segment when it arrives later this year. It features the same unmistakable, muscular form – now driven by a fully electric powertrain to deliver effortless, visceral performance.

Range Rover Sport Electric integrates a suite of advanced technologies that unleash more power and torque, amplified by an advanced new chassis tune and audio sound, creating a drive that feels as distinctive as it is visceral, across any terrain.

Electric power brings a new edge to Range Rover Sport. This model will redefine performance SUVs again later this year, combining the refinement and immediate performance of electric drive while further elevating the unmistakable character of Range Rover Sport our clients already know and love.

Electric power brings a new edge to Range Rover Sport. This model will redefine performance SUVs again later this year, combining the refinement and immediate performance of electric drive while further elevating the unmistakable character of Range Rover Sport our clients already know and love.

The addition of pure‑electric propulsion later this year will complete the powertrain line‑up for Range Rover Sport, with a plug‑in electric hybrid, mild‑hybrid V8 petrol and six‑cylinder petrol and diesel offering a suitable option for every client. New Range Rover Sport Electric has been calibrated to deliver the same thrilling, engaging drive that defines the sportiest expression of the brand.
Further details of Range Rover Sport Electric will be announced later this year.

Every Range Rover is curated for our clients – people who move with purpose, vision and integrity. With modernist design, serene and connected interiors, and effortlessly capable electrified performance, each vehicle offers a calm sanctuary that supports leadership in motion. Inspired by exemplary design since 1970.

The Range Rover family includes Range Rover, Range Rover Sport, Range Rover Velar and Range Rover Evoque. As part of our vision of modern luxury by design, every Range Rover is available as an electric hybrid, with fully electric models arriving before 2030.
Range Rover is one of the world’s leading British luxury brands, sold in 121 countries. It forms part of JLR's portfolio of distinctive British brands.

JLR is constantly seeking ways to improve the specification, design and production of its vehicles, parts and accessories and alterations take place continually. Whilst every effort is made to produce up‑to‑date literature, this document should not be regarded as an infallible guide to current specifications or availability, nor does it constitute an offer for the sale of any particular vehicle, part or accessory.
